title: 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Trims and Specs Comparison
summary: Compare 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 trim levels, specs, and features. Learn the differences between Work Truck, Custom, LT, RST, LTZ, High Country, and ZR2 trims.
body_markdown:
The **[2022 Chevrolet Silverado 1500](https://www.cargurus.com/research/2022-Chevrolet-Silverado-1500-c31830)** marks a landmark year for Chevy's flagship full-size pickup, with a comprehensive mid-cycle refresh that overhauled its technology, cabin, and off-road capability.


*Note: Chevrolet briefly produced the carryover Silverado 1500 Limited alongside the fully refreshed 2022 model. This guide covers the refreshed 2022 lineup.*


Updates for the refreshed 2022 Silverado include a new interior design on LT trims and above, built around a 13.4-inch horizontal infotainment touchscreen and a 12.3-inch configurable digital driver display. Chevrolet also upgraded the 2.7-liter Turbo engine to 430 lb-ft of torque, made Super Cruise hands-free driving available on High Country models, and introduced the first-ever Silverado ZR2, a factory off-road racer fitted with Multimatic DSSV spool-valve dampers.


Spanning nine trim levels, the 2022 Silverado 1500 lineup runs from basic work rigs to high-tech luxury haulers and hardcore trail machines.

## 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Trim Levels Breakdown


### Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Work Truck


The Work Truck (WT) is the no-nonsense fleet and job-site workhorse:


- 2.7-liter Turbo High-Output engine generating 310 horsepower and 430 lb-ft of torque
- Available 5.3-liter EcoTec3 V8 producing 355 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque
- 7-inch color touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Chevy Safety Assist suite with Automatic Emergency Braking, Forward Collision Alert, and Lane Keep Assist
- Durable vinyl or cloth seating with rubberized vinyl floor covering
- CornerStep rear bumper and 12 cargo tie-downs


The WT covers the essential towing capability, safety, and durability for budget-conscious commercial or personal buyers.


### Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Custom


The Custom adds popular appearance upgrades and daily convenience features over the base WT:


- 20-inch Bright Silver-painted aluminum wheels and body-color bumpers
- 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat with power lumbar support
- Remote start, keyless open and start, and EZ Lift power lock and release tailgate
- SiriusXM satellite radio capability and trial
- Available Custom Value Package adding trailer equipment and a rear-window defogger


### Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Custom Trail Boss


Built for off-road utility at an accessible price, the Custom Trail Boss pairs rugged mechanical upgrades with Custom styling:


- 2-inch factory suspension lift
- Z71 Off-Road Package with Rancho shocks, skid plates, and hill descent control
- 18-inch High Gloss Black aluminum wheels wrapped in Goodyear Wrangler DuraTrac mud-terrain tires
- Autotrac 2-speed transfer case and Eaton G80 automatic locking rear differential
- Gloss-black front grille, black bumpers, and recovery hooks


### Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LT


The LT is where the 2022 Silverado's interior refresh begins, making it the sweet spot for modern tech and comfort:


- Redesigned interior with a 13.4-inch color touchscreen and Google built-in
- 12.3-inch reconfigurable digital driver information center
- LED reflector headlights and signature daytime running lights
- 17-inch Bright Silver aluminum wheels and chrome front and rear bumpers
- Dual-zone automatic climate control, heated front seats, and heated steering wheel


### Chevrolet Silverado 1500 RST


The RST gives the refreshed LT layout an aggressive, street-inspired look:


- Body-color center grille bar, door handles, and front and rear bumpers
- 18-inch High Gloss Black aluminum wheels, with 20-inch and 22-inch options available
- Full LED lighting package including fog lights, headlights, and taillights
- 13.4-inch touchscreen and 12.3-inch digital cluster
- Available bucket front seats with center floor console


### Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LT Trail Boss


The LT Trail Boss merges the high-tech LT and RST interior with hardcore off-road hardware:


- 2-inch factory suspension lift with Z71 Off-Road suspension and Rancho monotube shocks
- 5.3-liter V8, with an available 6.2-liter V8 or 3.0-liter Duramax turbo-diesel
- 18-inch High Gloss Black wheels with Goodyear Wrangler DuraTrac tires
- 13.4-inch touchscreen with center console shifter
- E-Locker automatic locking rear differential and underbody skid plates


### Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LTZ


The LTZ moves the Silverado into luxury truck territory with premium materials and advanced towing tech:


- Perforated leather-appointed front seats with 10-way power adjustment, heating, and ventilation
- 20-inch polished aluminum wheels and full chrome exterior accents
- Advanced Trailering System with up to 14 camera views, including transparent trailer view
- Bose 7-speaker premium audio system with Richbass woofer
- Power tilt and telescoping steering column and wireless charging pad


### Chevrolet Silverado 1500 High Country


The crown jewel of the comfort lineup, the High Country delivers top-tier luxury and the most advanced driver assistance:


- Open-pore wood trim, leather seating, and custom stitching
- 5.3-liter V8, with an available 6.2-liter V8 or 3.0-liter Duramax diesel
- Power-deployable running boards with bed access step
- High Country metallic grille with bronze accents and 20-inch machined aluminum wheels
- Available Super Cruise hands-free driver assistance, which works even while towing


### Chevrolet Silverado 1500 ZR2


The ZR2 is Chevrolet's ultimate factory-built off-road machine, engineered for high-speed desert running and technical rock crawling:


- 420-horsepower 6.2-liter EcoTec3 V8 paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission
- Multimatic DSSV 40mm spool-valve dampers for extreme off-road damping and refined street control
- Driver-selectable front and rear electronic locking differentials
- Off-road cut front bumper for a 31.8-degree approach angle, plus heavy-duty aluminum skid plates
- 33-inch Goodyear Wrangler Territory mud-terrain tires on 18-inch gloss-black wheels
- Black hood insert, unique ZR2 grille with flow-tie emblem, and Terrain Mode for one-pedal rock crawling


If serious trail capability is the priority, the ZR2 is the one to get.

## Powertrain & Specs: Engine Options, Towing, and Capability


The 2022 Silverado 1500 offers four powertrains, so you can pick the exact balance of torque, fuel economy, and towing capacity.


### Gas Engines


- 2.7-liter Turbo High-Output 4-cylinder: 310 hp, 430 lb-ft, 8-speed automatic, max towing 9,500 lbs
- 5.3-liter EcoTec3 V8: 355 hp, 383 lb-ft, 10-speed automatic, max towing 11,200 lbs
- 6.2-liter EcoTec3 V8: 420 hp, 460 lb-ft, 10-speed automatic, max towing 13,300 lbs


### The 3.0L Duramax Turbo-Diesel I6


The diesel makes 277 hp and 460 lb-ft through a 10-speed automatic, matches the 6.2-liter V8's 13,300-lb maximum tow rating, and returns an EPA-estimated 23 mpg city and 31 mpg highway. It's the pick if you cover long highway miles with a trailer behind you.


## Which 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Trim is the Best Value?


For most truck buyers, the LT is the best overall value in the lineup. It unlocks the redesigned interior with the 13.4-inch touchscreen and 12.3-inch digital gauge cluster, and it can be had with the efficient 2.7-liter Turbo High-Output engine or the available V8 and diesel powertrains at a reasonable price.


If you head off-pavement regularly, the Custom Trail Boss delivers the most capability per dollar. You get the 2-inch factory lift, locking rear differential, and mud-terrain tires without paying for luxury cabin upgrades.


**Our pick:** Choose the LT for everyday technology and comfort, the RST for sporty street style, or the Custom Trail Boss for affordable trail work. Step up to the High Country or ZR2 for premium luxury or extreme off-roading.


## Are You Interested in Buying a 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 1500?


Whether you want the high-tech cabin of the LT, the efficiency of the Duramax diesel, or the desert-racing capability of the ZR2, the 2022 Silverado 1500 remains a top choice in the full-size pickup market.
